scope: diagnostic copies of actual V7 VIO, no estimator math/state/threshold/feature-selection changes
record_header: diagnostics.h 7 uint64 fields; data doubles row-major; negative iteration/level represented as uint64 two-complement; true stage/source stamp supplied by caller

1.notes: Candidate visits include raycast revisits. feature point counts sum valid voxel entries. NCC disabled logs NaN evaluation/rejection counts, not zero. total_points and accepted_tracks duplicated deliberately for stable reader fields.

3.notes: Original VIO covariance is updated once after all levels/iterations. On zero-track skip P/state unchanged, G=NaN (not applied). No per-iteration covariance update is fabricated.

201.description: every actual VIO update iteration in both forward and inverse composition branches, plus explicit zero-track skipped event
notes: post_update_error is NaN because original algorithm does not reevaluate residual immediately after applying solution; next iteration candidate error is the real reevaluation.
On rollback actual current residual H/z are still recorded; diagnostic-only HtH/HTz recomputation copies them and does not enter solver. No applied solver solution exists; logged solution is NaN.
P19_after_iteration normally equals before because covariance is only updated at end of frame (kind200 phase3).
accepted_state_update records original error<=last_error branch, not a new diagnostic acceptance rule.
All original branches, including nonfinite/zero-count behavior, retained unchanged.

202.description: actual accepted retrieval tracks in fixed detail window
202.notes: IDs are diagnostic-only per-manager IDs assigned to persistent VisualPoint pointer; actual reference IDs were initialized during feature creation. Frame-source stamps stored for every processed nonempty image. No uninitialized Feature grad/score or VisualPoint fields are read. Raw patch arrays/hash omitted; actual scalar retrieval SSE/NCC and H/z retained separately.

203.description: actual pixel H_sub/z arrays for first and terminating/max iterations at every level in fixed detail window
203.notes: Logger copies completed arrays after original update/rollback branch; they are not fed back. Allows independent reconstruction of kind201 HtH/R and HTz/R.

static_equivalence.method: strip all complete FASTLIVO_DIAG_BEGIN/END blocks; source and header exactly match previously frozen original byte for byte

limitations: Compile/runtime verification performed by root after merging; this schema alone is not runtime success.
Diagnostic CPU and finite writer queue can affect timing; drops or stale protective stops invalidate complete diagnostic claims.
Raw patch images are not saved by this VIO instrumentation.
Reference deletes are not separately counted; added reference observations are actual update_num; actual accepted observation_count/age provided per detail track.

V11_collection_scope.VIO_retrieval_frame_cov_and_iteration_ki: detail-only; exceptional skip kind200 remains original
V11_collection_scope.kind4: detail_at(offset-corrected source header) using profile-defined window; raw record original header unchanged
